mina: Hi team, I'm Mina - new shadow this week. Quick blockers: PD shows 'no permissions' when I try to acknowledge. Also can't access the jumpbox (ssh timed out). Who do I ping?

kai: welcome Mina! If PD shows that, you're probably in the observer group. Ping @ops-iam for SCIM add. For jumpbox, check you have the `oncall-shadow` IAM role and the SSH key uploaded to your profile.

ops-iam: Mina, I see a pending SCIM invite for you. I've added a ticket OPS-1302 to add you to oncall-users and triggered the jumpbox ACL refresh. Please try PD ack and ssh after 5 minutes.

oncall-trainer-bot: Reminder: shadow checklist -> PD notifications verified, jumpbox SSH + AWS read-only, Grafana dashboards open, and recent 24h incidents reviewed. Link: https://confluence.internal/redwood/oncall/checklist

mina: Thanks. Quick question: during a noisy deploy, should shadows mute alerts or annotate and escalate? Don't want to break things.

kai: Annotate first with 'deploy' and follow the deploy rollback checklist. Only use targeted mutes for non-customer-impacting metrics. If customer-facing errors persist, escalate. The runbook has short rules under "Alert Handling".

sre-oncall-bot: Rotation update: Mina assigned as shadow -> primary on 2026-04-20 08:00 UTC. Training mock scheduled if needed.

mina: Ack works now and I can ssh. Ops-1302 resolved, thanks @ops-iam. Can someone run a 20-min mock with me at 13:30 UTC to practice PD escalation and postmortem sketch?

kai: I'll run the mock at 13:30. We'll simulate p99 latency spike and exercise triage + PD escalation. Meet in #eng-oncall.

mina: Awesome, thanks everyone! :sparkles:
